summary: Shows increasing parallelism by setting `forks` in ansible.cfg `[defaults]` or with `-f` on the command line.
questions: How do I make Ansible run on more hosts in parallel?
How do I change the number of forks?
What's the command line flag for forks?

answer_card.title: Set the number of forks
answer_card.answer_md:
In `ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[defaults]
forks = 30
```
Or on the command line:
```bash
ansible-playbook -f 30 my_playbook.yml
```
